Name: PFM Pottery Kiln
Author: sylvarmyst
Description:
[size=4][b]This mod is broken as of 1.6.
The 1.6 updated version was made by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Syanide23?gameId=1303]Syanide23[/url] and can be found [size=4][b] can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29890]here[/url]﻿[/b][/size]
Many thanks to them !
[/b][/size]
Updated to PFM by [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/77289063-hadiwrites42/]hadiwrites42[/url]﻿ ! Many thanks to them, I literally would not have been able to make this conversion myself. This mod is a million times better now thanks to their hard work ^^

Adds a new functional machine to the game that can be used to produce 61 unique ceramic pots ! Each pot is made using clay and another material which will determine the glaze color of the pottery produced.
Materials that can be used as glaze for pottery kiln include:
 [list]
[*]All metal ores
[*]All [url=http://https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Minerals]foraged minerals[/url]﻿
[*]All [url=http://https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Minerals]gems[/url]﻿
[*]All [url=http://https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Minerals]geode minerals[/url]﻿
[*]Rainbow shells
[*]Solar essence
[*]Void essence
[*]Clay itself (makes a very simple pot)
[/list]
The kiln is a recolor of the charcoal kiln and can be purchased from Clint for 5000 gold. The kiln uses 5 clay as a starter.

The time required to produce each pot is determined by its monetary value. Cheaper pots will take one hour to produce. Mid-range pots will take two hours. The most valuable pots will take 5 hours, except for the Prismatic Pot, which takes 10 hours.

This mod requires: 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]﻿

A big thank you to the creators of those mods, as I wouldn't have been able to create this without the wonderful resources/tools they've created!
